stopRules.ga8: the confirmatory G-A8 runs FIRST. Thresholds copied verbatim from ga8_registration_3aB.json. STOP (dominant): win rate >= 0.60 AND the lower 95% bound > 0.55, for any of the 21 templates. Control: std vs std must have a win rate within 0.50 +/- 0.05 (instrument sanity); outside => STOP(INSTRUMENT). A STOP halts every other formal measurement and the release; it is reported to the Owner. No relaxed threshold, no new seeds, no template dropped, no scope change after the fact
stopRules.warn: a G-A8 WARN (win rate >= 0.57 or <= 0.43) is not a STOP, as in the original registration; every WARN is listed by template in the report and the Owner sees it before any release decision
stopRules.inconclusive: INCONCLUSIVE, undecided or data-incomplete in any step is NOT a pass: the release decision waits for the Owner
stopRules.challenge: the Challenge side-bias STOP stays. Stage 1 does not measure it and never claims it passed
stopRules.anyOtherRed: any other pre-registered check that fails stops the release decision and is reported. There is no automatic fix and no automatic restart: any change needs a new Owner ruling and a new freeze, and that ruling decides the seed policy for every observed block (43001-43400 and the others of this spec are observed once run). This spec authorises neither re-using them nor drawing new ones
stopRules.optionalStopping: each study runs to its registered n; no peeking decision; errored seeds follow errorRule (> 1% STOP); an interrupted run resumes in the same folder on the same fingerprint

verifyBaseline: verify.mjs has many long-standing segment failures, far more than knownDebts (the last local state shows 67 of 118, mostly CS and milestone; it is a git-ignored file and not evidence). So the baseline is produced mechanically, not written by hand: a full verify run on origin/main at the commit stage 1 branches from, in a separate worktree, BEFORE step 1, stored as tools/fixtures/stage1_verify_baseline_3aB.json with each failing segment name and failure text. It is never edited afterwards
ownerDecisionsBeforeFreeze: G-A8 tests each template without choices. E1 / E2 arms were not designed around table templates plus choices, so a table template combined with a choice may never get a win-rate test. The Owner decides, before the freeze, whether stage 1 adds such a test or accepts this gap
